cells.title: Finding patterns in Deborah Hay's work.

additional_fields.html-content:
Discovering patterns in Deborah Hay's work

"… for somebody who feels like I’ve been spending the last 40 years of my life undoing the continuity of my patterning, I am shocked by the amount of patterns that are emerging." Deborah Hay Interview June 2012



Deborah Hay's choreographic approach embraces variability. The notes in No Time To Fly are explicit. On Tab 17 of the score text: "The movement may change, but the choreography itself does not change." By filming as many versions as possible, and extracting two kinds of data -- pathway and marker (time variance) -- from this material, regularities in the performances began to show up.



Another data set was also extracted from the material. The silhouettes of each performer.



Read more about these data extractions and pattern searching in Deborah Hay's process documentation.
